findings.problem: G5 split skeleton step 2.2 into 2.2a (churches/settings/fellowships) and 2.2b (admins, billing, super-admins). BillingPanel.tsx, StripeBanner.tsx, billing-actions.ts and /admin/churches/[orgId]/billing are produced by 2.2b, so a dependency on the non-existent id '2.2' breaks the chain.
findings.fix: Set depends_on to ["2.2b"] and, in Inputs / prior state, replace 'Step 2.2 produced' with 'Step 2.2b produced' (2.2a for the churches list / Settings tab).

findings.quote: `deps` is an object `{ stripe: Stripe, db: SupabaseClient<Database> }`
findings.problem: Build item 3 defines deps as { stripe, db: SupabaseClient } while Build item 11 requires a `BillingRepo` interface with a Supabase-backed and a Map-backed implementation so tests avoid supabase-js mocking; item 4 additionally reads `deps.webhookSecret`. The agent gets two incompatible dependency shapes.
findings.fix: Define once in Build item 3: `export interface BillingRepo { getEvent(id); insertEvent(row); markEvent(id, {processed_at, error}); getCustomerByOrg(orgId); getCustomerByStripeId(id); upsertCustomer(row); getOrg(orgId); getSubscription(id); upsertSubscription(row); listRecentEvents(n) }`, `export function supabaseBillingRepo(db: SupabaseClient<Database>): BillingRepo`, and `type Deps = { stripe: Stripe | null; repo: BillingRepo; webhookSecret: string }`. Make items 3–7 and 11 use `deps.repo` consistently; drop the `db` wording.

findings.problem: G5's 2.2b builds the Billing tab as its own route `/admin/churches/[orgId]/billing` (its build output lists it). Redirecting to `/admin/churches/${orgId}` lands on the Details tab, so the `?billing=success|cancelled` toast described in item 8 never fires and the portal `return_url` returns to the wrong tab.
findings.fix: Use `${appUrl()}/admin/churches/${orgId}/billing?billing=success`, `.../billing?billing=cancelled` and portal `return_url: ${appUrl()}/admin/churches/${orgId}/billing`; in item 8 say the search param is read by `app/(super)/admin/churches/[orgId]/billing/page.tsx`.

findings.problem: G5's 2.1 already exports the non-redirecting `getAuthContext()` (→ null or `{userId, isSuperAdmin, orgs, profile}`) in `src/lib/auth/context.ts`; inventing `getSuperAdminContext()` duplicates it and the open_issues entry asks the assembler to align.
findings.fix: Replace Build 6.2 with: 'Authorise with `getAuthContext()` from `src/lib/auth/context.ts` (2.1): `null` or `!ctx.isSuperAdmin` → 401 JSON. Never authorise with the service client.' Update Build 12 ('mock `getAuthContext` to return null') and delete the `getSuperAdminContext()` open issue.

findings.quote: When not configured render an `Alert` (shadcn) "Stripe is not configured on this deployment…"
findings.problem: 2.2b already ships `src/features/orgs/StripeBanner.tsx` ('2.3 reuses this banner component'), `src/features/orgs/billing-actions.ts` and a read-only subscription card with disabled Checkout/Portal buttons. Item 8 tells the agent to build the alert, the subscription card and the badge from scratch, which duplicates 2.2b.
findings.fix: Reword item 8: 'Reuse `src/features/orgs/StripeBanner.tsx` (2.2b) for the not-configured state, keep the Server Actions in `src/features/orgs/billing-actions.ts`, and extend the existing read-only subscription card in `BillingPanel.tsx` (badge colours, `status_raw`, `current_period_end`, `cancel_at_period_end`) instead of adding a second card.'

findings.quote: Do not pin `apiVersion`; the SDK's bundled version is the one its types describe.
findings.problem: DESIGN §3 says `stripe` 22.6.1 with '`apiVersion` pinned to the SDK's bundled version in `stripe/client.ts`'. The prompt gives the opposite instruction without noting the DESIGN wording (orchestrator decision 10: PLAN wins, DESIGN wording noted).
findings.fix: Replace with: 'Leave `apiVersion` unset so the SDK uses its bundled version — this is what DESIGN §3 means by "pinned to the SDK's bundled version"; do not hard-code a date string.'

findings.problem: DESIGN §8 says 'idempotency key = org id' for Checkout/Portal. A `Date.now()` suffix makes every click a new key, i.e. no idempotency; the deviation is not recorded.
findings.fix: Either use a key stable per attempt (e.g. a client-generated `attemptId` posted in the body, `checkout:${orgId}:${attemptId}`) or keep the timestamp and add 'record in HANDOFF "Deviations from plan": Checkout idempotency key is per attempt, not per org, because a per-org key would return an expired session after 24 h' to the Finish block.

findings.quote: `billing_customers` (at least `org_id` and `stripe_customer_id`; use whatever 1.2 created) … If `stripe_events` has no `org_id` column (1.2 decides)
findings.problem: G2's 1.2 already fixed both: `billing_customers (org_id pk fk cascade, stripe_customer_id text not null unique, email citext, created_at, updated_at)` and `stripe_events` with DESIGN's columns only (no `org_id`). Leaving it conditional makes the agent guess and leaves `email` unused.
findings.fix: State the columns: `billing_customers (org_id uuid pk → organizations, stripe_customer_id text not null unique, email citext, created_at, updated_at)`; `ensureCustomer` stores `email = contact_email`. Say `stripe_events` has no `org_id`, so Build item 9 shows the global last-10 list on `/admin` (super admins only) and no per-org list; drop the 'if' branches.

findings.quote: `defaultWebhookDeps()` must not throw when Stripe is unconfigured
findings.problem: `defaultWebhookDeps()` is used in Build item 5 but never defined; item 3 only defines `defaultDeps()` which throws when Stripe is null.
findings.fix: In Build item 4 add: '`export function defaultWebhookDeps(): Deps` → `{ stripe: getStripe(), repo: supabaseBillingRepo(createServiceSupabase()), webhookSecret: stripeConfig().webhookSecret }` — never throws; the handler answers 503 when `webhookSecret` is empty or `stripe` is null.'

findings.problem: Step 1.1 also created a root `.env.example` listing every env var; only the web copy is updated.
findings.fix: Add 'and the root `.env.example` (1.1) — keep both files in sync' to Build item 10.

findings.quote: Exact expected counts are in `supabase/README.md` (section "Hosted verification").
findings.problem: G3's 1.5 prompt defines the README sections ('What is in this folder', 'First-time production bootstrap', 'How it is tested', 'Local development', 'Never', …) and none is called 'Hosted verification' or lists expected object counts. The founder is sent to a section that will not exist, and the `pg_policies … -- > 60` figure in step 6 is invented.
findings.fix: Either (a) add to open_issues: 'Assembler: 1.5's `supabase/README.md` must gain a "Hosted verification" subsection under "First-time production bootstrap" with the measured counts (public tables, private tables, `ca_*` policies, `app.*` functions, `srv_*` functions, buckets + limits) and the five read-only queries from 2.4 step 6', or (b) drop the README reference and make step 6 self-sufficient: expect 38 public tables, 3 private tables, 7 `srv_*`, 5 private buckets with `sermon-media` = 52428800, and 'policies = the row count of the policy table in `docs/RLS.md`' (1.5 asserts that equality) instead of '> 60'.

findings.quote: The HANDOFF "Applied migrations (hosted Supabase)" ledger must still read "(none yet)" … replace "(none yet)" with
findings.problem: G3's 1.5 rewrites the ledger to a placeholder row `9999_init.sql | _not yet_ |` plus the note 'Add a row the moment a file is pasted'. The founder will not find '(none yet)'.
findings.fix: In the preamble and in step 8 (and helper Build 3) say: 'the ledger row for `9999_init.sql` still reads `_not yet_`; fill that row in as `| 9999_init.sql (<short hash>) | <YYYY-MM-DD> | founder |`'.

findings.quote: sign in as that user in a private window → the "no church" screen is replaced by the church.
findings.problem: At Checkpoint A no `/o/[orgSlug]/*` page exists (they arrive in 3.1); 2.1 ships only a placeholder landing at `/o` and 3.1 documents 404 on `/o/<slug>`. The founder will read the placeholder as a failure and open a needless 2.6 run.
findings.fix: Replace with: 'sign in as that user in a private window → sign-in succeeds and lands on the `/o` placeholder page from 2.1 (the church pages arrive in step 3.1; a 404 on `/o/<slug>/dashboard` is expected now). Confirm the membership instead in `/admin/churches/<orgId>` → Admins tab: both accounts listed as active with 12 permissions.' Mirror this in done_when item 7 and the helper's Inputs.

findings.problem: `/s/[token]` is built in 3.4; at 2.5 the URL returns Next's generic not-found page. The wording makes the founder look for a share-specific page.
findings.fix: Reword: '`/s/unknown` → a 404 page (Next's default; the share-page 404 states arrive in 3.4)'. Same wording in done_when item 5.

findings.quote: you are signed in and see the "no church yet" screen (correct: you are nobody's member and not yet a super admin)
findings.problem: 2.1's post-login landing is `landingFor(ctx)` → `/o` placeholder for non-super users; there is no screen named 'no church yet' on web (that is the mobile `no-church` route).
findings.fix: Reword: 'you are signed in and land on the `/o` placeholder page from 2.1 (you are nobody's member and not yet a super admin, so `/admin` still redirects)'.

findings.quote: Deployments → latest → "⋯" → **Redeploy** (env changes apply only to new builds).
findings.problem: `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` is inlined at build time; a redeploy that reuses the build cache can keep the provisional value. 2.6's DEPLOY.md mentions this but 2.5 — where it actually happens — does not.
findings.fix: Append: 'untick "Use existing Build Cache" because `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` values are baked into the bundle'.
